objective: Extend the full per-feature fuzzy TopK mechanism dataset to the 500M dense-equivalent active-compute tier with the same three paired seeds and cadence-10 observer.

active_compute_match.basis: Choose the whole fuzzy depth nearest the dense 500M FLOPs-per-token anchor, then round the fuzzy schedule to the nearest whole optimizer step at the dense total active matrix-FLOP budget.
active_compute_match.semantic_fuzzy_mlp_rule: 2*D*H + 10*K*D training matrix FLOPs per token and layer

instrumentation.capture_schedule: optimizer step 1, every 10 steps, and the exact final optimizer step
instrumentation.runtime_isolation: The stateless forward-only observer runs before the unchanged ordinary optimizer executable on capture steps. Only the controller transfers and appends the replicated vector tensor.

feasibility_gate.reason: This is the first 1.073B-stored-parameter fuzzy run at 8k context on v4-32.
feasibility_gate.acceptance: Compilation, memory use, collectives, optimizer steps, feature captures, and validation must complete without a systems error. The development gate is excluded from the mechanism dataset archive.

launch_policy: Wait for all nine parent-ladder cells to complete and verify. Run one 120-step feasibility gate, then launch seeds 1337, 1338, and 1339 sequentially. Do not retry, select, or stop based on intermediate loss or sparsity observations.
stopping_rule: Every admitted seed runs through the complete explicit cosine schedule. Any parent verification or systems failure stops the dependent queue for inspection.
